definitionZh: 规则宽的 CSS 短手属性定义了多排网格,弹性,和多列布局的沟槽中绘制的任何线条的宽度,将列和行规则的宽度设定为相同的值.
sourceDefinition: The rule-width CSS shorthand property defines the widths of any lines drawn in the gutters of multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting the widths of the column and row rules to the same value.
